exposure: decision-to-delivery time > 1 hour for emergency caesarean section
more than 3 vaginal examinations after membrane rupture
cohort: The study participants were mother-baby pairs where babies were term and delivered by caesarean section, categorized into cases (with early-onset neonatal sepsis within 72 hours) and controls (without early-onset neonatal sepsis).
finding: Prime gravidity, antepartum hemorrhage, multiple vaginal examinations after membrane rupture, long decision-to-delivery time, and maternal referral status were significantly associated with an increased risk of early-onset neonatal sepsis among term babies delivered by caesarean section.
